name: google/elephant-goldfish-model
description: Spec design and review plugin. Elephant holds project context and drafts the specification; Goldfish reviewers stress-test it with zero-context subagents before code is written. The plugin ships skills including egm-bootstrap, egm-brainstorm, egm-draft, egm-review, and egm-drift-report.
install: claude plugin marketplace add google/elephant-goldfish-model && claude plugin install egm@egm
